dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Haha, so this is the Spiritway... That was quick. I wasn't expecting this experience.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: We took all this time to get to our destination, and "whoop," it took us all the way back in an instant. Fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the Pyro Archon should be placing this stuff everywhere!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you never entered a Spiritway before?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, I've always lived within my tribe's bounds, and we have phlogiston-saturated winds nearby that can blow us high into the sky over there...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Still, I feel like these Spiritways are slightly more fun.
